text:
Summary: FOREO had 15 mentions and 19% share of voice, tied with CurrentBody. Therabody leads in AU with 100% coverage, and in the US, Therabody leads with 40% coverage. Competitors dominate in skin science and business topics, with 23% and 15% respectively. A Therabody recall headline is in the news.  
Actions:  
- Pitch popsugar.com, which covered competitors but not FOREO, with a story on skin science and product safety.  
- Pitch wareable.com, which covered competitors but not FOREO, with a story on skin science and business topics.  
- Offer a skin science story to menshealth.com, which covered competitors but not FOREO, to address the 23% competitor lead.
style: two actions say the same thing
